paragraphs: R. Muna, a tanna of a baraita, Sifra, Metzora, verses 15, 25 [the source's locators]. R. Gamliel son of R. Ḥanina asked before R. Muna. R. Muna and R. Ḥanina disagree, Midrash Rabbah, end of Bamidbar.
